rationale: Web-only exit UB/main-loop cleanup fix; self-contained but platform/web is not compiled or verifiable in the macOS editor build, so defer.
Adds Metal framework in ANGLE link branch, but fork base macos detect.py uses a different (older) ANGLE structure and already links Metal for the Metal driver; needs adaptation and is low value.

Trivial Vector2i integer-scaling fix for embedded warp_mouse, but targets display_server_macos_embedded (renamed from base's display_server_embedded by #106814); blocked on that embedded rename/refactor.

Fixes poll_export mutating the current export_preset; replacement helpers has_valid_export_configuration/has_valid_project_configuration exist in base and web export_plugin.cpp compiles into the macOS editor.
Removes web link flags blocking proxy_to_pthread; platform/web build-only, not compiled/verifiable here.
Makes web Emscripten assertions configurable; web build-script only, not compiled/verifiable in macOS build.
Adds window-existence checks to HDR output methods, but HDR/EDR output infra (window_is_hdr_output_*) does not exist in the fork base; blocked on #106814 (f1ce0e6).
Embedded game window hiDPI scaling fix, but built on display_server_macos_embedded (renamed/refactored from base's display_server_embedded by #106814); blocked on that embedded rework.
ANGLE angle_path fallback depends on the 'env[angle]' + arch-suffixed angle_libs path structure introduced by #117445, which is absent in the fork's older ANGLE detect.py; blocked on #117445.

Splits EGL includes into per-platform platform_egl.h (new file absent in base) across GLES3/EGL plumbing; GLES3 is not the fork's primary macOS path, refactor is not build-verifiable and touches diverged driver code.
Emits window events on HDR state changes; depends on the HDR/EDR output infrastructure that is absent in the fork base. Blocked on #106814 (f1ce0e6).

Accessibility fix: set FOCUS_NONE on ScrollContainer scroll bars in scene/gui/scroll_container.cpp (compiled, verifiable). The detect.py hunk only removes a duplicated accesskit include that does not exist in the fork base; drop it and port only the scroll_container change.

Large ANGLE build reorg (remove dynamic linking, add enable flag, install_angle.py, glad patch) plus CI workflow edits; fork's ANGLE detect.py and CI are diverged and ANGLE is not built/verified here. High conflict, low value.
One-line determinism fix: sort extra_frameworks before emitting -framework flags to stabilize macOS incremental link order.
Includes core/typedefs.h in display_server_macos_base.h to prevent AppKit MAX/MIN macro clashes; base file exists, clean one-liner.
Adds encoding='utf-8' to the SVG open in platform_builders.py icon generator; runs during the macOS build, trivial and safe.

Forces ANGLE (GL-over-Metal) when running in a VM (Virtual processor name) and fails cleanly if ANGLE init fails; GLES3 gl_manager_angle block exists in base. Behavioral, valuable for VM/software-render CI; verify against fork's rendering_driver handling.
Passes the current process environment to child processes in create_process (fixes Steam time tracking on project relaunch); self-contained in os_macos.mm.
Wake for events when Magnet window manager is running to avoid stalled redraws; self-contained in os_macos.mm add_frame_delay.
Guards a macOS 26 API (CGDirectDisplayID) behind __MAC_OS_X_VERSION_MAX_ALLOWED so builds work with Xcode older than 26; valuable for local macOS builds.
Adds nullptr checks for script_debugger in LayerHost::gui_input; embedded_process_macos.mm exists in the fork base, clean defensive fix.

Large EDR/HDR output feature (24 files) touching Metal/Vulkan drivers, iOS/visionOS, and renaming display_server_embedded->display_server_macos_embedded with big display_server_macos refactors. Foundational for several later HDR/embedded PRs but a heavy, risky feature port; sequence deliberately.

Rewrites confined-mouse warp math to use screen coordinates so confined movement stays in sync; self-contained in display_server_macos.mm and verifiable on macOS. Behavioral, test mouse-confine after port.

Appends build name to bundle ID and switches to get_version_info, but platform_macos_builders.py is heavily fork-diverged (Foundry rebrand, get_build_version helper, no org.godotengine.godot string); needs manual adaptation, low value.
Include-hygiene refactor across 59 files spanning editor/, servers/display, scene/, and all platforms; conflicts heavily with the fork's diverged editor/servers code for no functional gain.
Adds a null check on the NSURL before building an NSBundle in get_framework_executable; self-contained defensive fix in os_macos.mm.

Adds taskbar progress/state API to DisplayServer + Window for macOS/Windows; additive and macOS-compilable, but it is a new cross-platform API (servers/display, scene/main/window, docs) rather than a fix. Defer as a feature; mechanical FOUNDRY_CLASS/rebrand adaptation needed.

Marks main() with __attribute__((visibility(default))); trivial. Target file is foundry_main_macos.mm in the fork (rename from godot_main_macos.mm). Pairs with #109958 (114cb3a) hidden default visibility.
Disables FP contraction for iOS/visionOS detect.py to match macOS; iOS/visionOS are not compiled by the macOS build, so not verifiable here. Low-risk parity fix, defer.
Fixes 'Show In File Manager' launching bundle apps by checking DirAccess::is_bundle (present in base) before treating a path as a folder; self-contained in os_macos.mm.
Returns an empty IME rect when no text control is active to hide input-accessory popups; target is foundry_content_view.mm in the fork (rename from godot_content_view.mm).
One line: setTreatsFilePackagesAsDirectories:YES lets the native macOS dialog browse into bundles; self-contained in display_server_macos.mm.

Sets default symbol visibility to hidden (-fvisibility=hidden) in macos detect.py; must be ported together with #115868 (a6623908) which re-exports main(), and check GDExtension/plugin symbol exports still resolve. Verifiable via macOS build.
Guards iOS OpenGLES code behind GLES3_ENABLED so iOS can build with opengl3=no; iOS is not compiled by the macOS build, so not verifiable here. Defer.
